request_flow.summary: The exact-raw HMAC webhook path validates the fixture vocabulary and resolves the original qualified payment transaction and reference. An independent connection must see the bounded receipt before acknowledgement.
The receipt worker locks the accepted purchase, binds the provider dispute identity, classifies revision or conflict and increments the durable effect version in the same transaction.

A first refund claim advances conflict-free restored Plan consequences for the exact purchase and payment under the same Purchase transaction. The claim and consequence versions commit together. Dispatch replay cannot advance them again.
The owning Entitlements transaction re-reads the current source effect. Applied versions are acknowledged separately, so a cut between transactions leaves recoverable work.

The projection requires current Finance and Audit IdentityGrant rows for the canonical actor, recipient, dispute and operation. It checks the signed and persisted Privacy purpose and deletion authority. Audit records the exact operation, actor, dispute, purpose and field set. An independent connection must see that committed assertion before the projection returns. Explicit caller transactions are denied.

security_invariants.summary: Dispute wire, handlers, workers, Ash actions and AshOban read authorization compile only in TEST. Network reads are GET to the original certificate-pinned loopback endpoint, without redirects or automatic retries.

The stored receipt contains only a digest, bounded normalized outcome data and a local bound payment identity. SQL query telemetry is suppressed on protected paths including the independent visibility observer.

Privacy suppresses restricted SQL telemetry around authority reads, grant and withdrawal writes and events, proof issuance, and failure reconciliation. The same bounded observer that checks receipt visibility also checks exact Audit visibility with protected SQL telemetry.

Finance and Audit reader capabilities use distinct role and scope pairs and confer no Support permission. Identity checks exact IDs, role, actor, recipient, dispute, operation, active period and unrevoked state in the projection transaction. TEST-only scope provisioning rejects self-approval and records the exact active approver grant used for issuance.

concurrency.summary: The purchase lock is shared by dispute ingress, qualification, refund dispatch claim and entitlement convergence. A pending bound receipt or current blocking dispute fences a new POST. An existing claim remains durable and cannot be repeated.

Dispute receipt persistence and terminal qualification take the same purchase lock. Precommitted opposing outcomes keep a known case suspended with the refund fence held in either processing order. The first terminal receipt for a still-unbound case binds as unresolved when its opposition is already committed. Loss qualified before opposition remains irreversible.

Refund claim and dispute delivery use the same Purchase lock. The refund owner's payment-scoped status keeps a restored dispute financially unresolved after an ambiguous, pending or failed claimed POST. Entitlements suspends the affected Plan right and ends it after qualified processed refund evidence. A delivery that commits first can restore access while clear, and the committed claim then fences reads immediately and advances the durable effect version for scheduler discovery.

Grant administration locks involved Accounts in identifier order. The projection retains the canonical reader Account lock before checking the two current grant rows. A competing grant revocation uses the same Account boundary and revokes the targeted disclosure grant under its independently authenticated Domain authority and clears elevated assurance through the existing Identity lifecycle.

idempotency_retry.summary: The receipt worker processes only pending rows. Any committed classification is terminal for that receipt. On replay Commerce rereads under the Purchase lock and leaves the case, effect version and receipt unchanged. The receipt scheduler skips classified rows. A failed classification transaction leaves the receipt pending for rediscovery.

After qualified restoration, the original outstanding payment grant and dispute delivery both check the current locked Identity recipient before a Plan right can become held. A temporary security hold leaves the grant pending. After release, either delivery order converges to one right for the original paid source.

Dispute identity and immutable receipt identity are separate. Replays of earlier revisions or obsolete read tokens cannot advance the owning case. The durable scheduled retry remains capped and due after the final round.
A later exact pinned confirmation covers older opposing revisions. An older disagreement with no newer pinned confirmation can still open a conflict.

failure_recovery.summary: The installed TEST receipt scheduler discovers a committed pending webhook receipt with missing or exhausted work in a fresh BEAM. Competing executions of the scheduled worker bind one dispute and advance the effect once. Separate fresh processes verify due known-case reads and pending consequence recovery.
Down migrations refuse to discard retained dispute, Privacy or Audit evidence or suspended rights. Cleanup selects only the tracked operation, exact payment or webhook digest and their jobs.

A stale read token prevents its receipt from applying an outcome. Its committed exact-source terminal revision still limits confirmation. A current pinned read can resolve an unsettled conflict when its revision is at least as high as same-outcome evidence and strictly newer than every opposing terminal revision. Repeating the same terminal outcome under a current reservation can apply after a superseded attempt.

AshOban 0.10.2 remains pinned. These triggers use generic actions. The owning code revalidates pending receipt, due read and effect state under the Purchase lock. The 0.10.3 update and destroy worker recheck change is distinct from those guards. Fresh BEAM proof executes the current pinned scheduler and workers.

The dispute delivery scheduler finds the newer unacknowledged version even after queue loss. An acknowledgement for a previous restoration cannot acknowledge this version. The refund owner continues same-reference reads until qualified processing and owns the terminal refund effect.

A fully acknowledged restoration receives a same-payment ambiguous claim. A pre-commit cut rolls back both writes. The fresh BEAM scheduler rediscovers suspension with no queued job and leaves an independent same-recipient right unchanged.

A refund claim between Entitlements commit and Commerce acknowledgement invalidates the older version. After removal of the queued work, a fresh BEAM delivers exactly once and a second scheduler pass creates no worker. Both Purchase lock orders and qualified processed refund ending use the actual scheduler.

The original outstanding grant and dispute delivery both reject a held recipient in either order. The grant remains open and no right exists until release. Replaying the original grant after release returns the same right.
Run-specific 20-digit provider identities and payment-scoped assertions preserve large numeric-ID and deliberate collision coverage in the shared TEST allocation.

An independent PostgreSQL observer sees the exact pending webhook before starting the fresh BEAM. The receipt scheduler recovers after missing or exhausted work and skips the classified receipt on replay. Competing workers leave one case, consequence version and original Plan right. Scoped teardown preserves an unrelated scheduled job.

A second payment can commit an authenticated receipt before the first payment binds the provider dispute identity. Processing the second receipt after the first bind quarantines it and preserves the independent right.

prohibited_shortcuts.summary: Do not infer component identity from a partial amount, classify financial settlement from access state, retry a claimed POST or create a right during correction delivery.
Do not disclose raw participant information, send evidence outside NewYou, activate Paystack or discover unknown disputes.

proof_limitations: Actual Paystack account configuration, dispute status and deadline vocabulary, Finance operations and release certification remain out of scope.
The local fixture records unresolved overlapping corrections and does not decide cancellation, netting or external adjudication.

Ash Signals and Temporal Resources were considered. The existing versioned Commerce consequence and immutable receipts provide scoped durable recovery and historical evidence without process-local authority or new dependencies.

Product Law section 15.1A and DEC-320 allow synthetic Domain approval roles to prove reader grant issuance and independent revocation in TEST. Finance and Audit scopes confer no production capability. Fixture revisions order local observations only.
